description: Deterministic golden conformance vector manifest for Bind ParserSpec runtimes (Mesh, TypeScript, ClickHouse SQL, Swift) per §5, §14, and §17.

suites.description: Golden conformance vectors covering word (including default class), int, and float hole classes with boundary values and overflow semantics.
Golden conformance vectors covering uuid, hex, ip (IPv4 and IPv6), and time (ISO 8601, Apache, syslog) hole classes.
Golden conformance vectors covering quoted, json (with SQL refusal tags), until (before all literal kinds), and rest hole classes.
Golden conformance vectors covering cast, scale (IEEE-754 single-op bit patterns), unit (all time and byte units), parse_time (all 10 formats), lower, and enum_map transforms.
Golden conformance vectors covering hash, mask (token and ip_prefix), drop, and Stage 2/3 redaction tokens across all 11 hole classes and field types (§5, §14).
Golden conformance vectors covering object (pure, nested, optional paths, message sub-patterns, SQL-refused message json holes) and args matchers.
Golden conformance vectors covering §5 canonical example, adjacent holes, UTF-8 non-ASCII cases (U+00A0, U+3000, combining marks, emoji), 64 KiB boundary records, and multi-field isolation.
